best_for: Windows 10 and 11 users who tweak their desktop daily and want window zones, a quick launcher, bulk rename and a color picker from Microsoft, free.

points.title: More than 30 small tools
points.text: FancyZones snaps windows into custom layouts, PowerToys Run and Command Palette launch apps, PowerRename renames files in bulk, and Text Extractor copies text from the screen. Color Picker, Image Resizer, Keyboard Manager, Peek and ZoomIt are in the box too.

points.title: Free and open source
points.text: PowerToys is MIT-licensed and developed in the open on GitHub. It also logs basic diagnostic data; Microsoft documents what it collects.

points.title: Elevated windows need elevation
points.text: When an app runs as administrator, tools such as FancyZones may not work while it has focus. PowerToys offers to restart as administrator when it notices one, or you can set it to always run elevated.

points.title: Requirements
points.text: Microsoft lists Windows 11 or Windows 10 version 2004 (build 19041) or newer on a 64-bit x64 or Arm64 PC. Setup installs the WebView2 runtime if it is missing.

points.title: Per-user or machine-wide
points.text: Installers come in per-user and machine-wide versions for x64 and Arm64. The per-user one needs no administrator rights and suits most single-user PCs. The listing keeps 118 versions, and there is no Mac or Linux build.
